description: This file defines a browser automation tool for OpenClaw, including functions for controlling browser tabs, snapshots, screenshots, navigation, and proxying browser commands through a gateway. It also provides configuration and dependency injection mechanisms.

methods.name: readOptionalTargetAndTimeout
methods.description: Parses targetId and timeoutMs from parameters.

methods.name: readTargetUrlParam
methods.description: Retrieves the target URL parameter from input parameters.

methods.name: readActRequestParam
methods.description: Constructs an act request object from parameters, supporting legacy keys.

methods.name: isBrowserNode
methods.description: Checks if a node has browser capabilities or commands.

methods.name: resolveBrowserNodeTarget
methods.description: Resolves a browser node target based on configuration, requested node, and available nodes.

methods.name: callBrowserProxy
methods.description: Sends a command via gateway to a browser proxy on a specific node.

methods.name: persistProxyFiles
methods.description: Persists files received from browser proxy.

methods.name: applyProxyPaths
methods.description: Applies path mappings to a result object.

methods.name: resolveBrowserBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for browser control based on configuration and target.

methods.name: shouldPreferHostForProfile
methods.description: Determines if a profile prefers host-based browser control.

methods.name: createBrowserTool
methods.description: Creates a browser automation tool with various actions like status, start, stop, open tab, snapshot, etc.
